description: Fork of exp194 (untied head, val_bpb≈2.07 @ 2.6K when stopped). Single change: V2D switched from linear_mode (raw x_a - x_b) to soft mode (x_a - x_b) / (t + |x_a - x_b|), bounded in (-1, 1). Hypothesis: linear V2D produces unbounded dominance values that act as a ill-conditioned linear pre-projection; soft mode gives a saturating, near-sign-like signal that better matches the role of attention features. NOTE: soft V2D output variance ≈0.92 vs linear ≈2, so Q magnitude shrinks by ~1.5x at qkv_std=0.005. Keeping qkv_std unchanged for a clean single-variable comparison.
